name: Experimental Prototype Cadre
legend: A handful of elite cadres are equipped with prototype technology from the most renowned applied science divisions of the T’au Empire. It is the honour of these Fire caste warriors to field test the newest of these advanced and ingenious weapon systems under true battlefield conditions.

rules.name: Superior Craftsmanship
rules.legend: The applied science divisions of the Earth caste labour endlessly to provide front-line units with expertly crafted instruments of destruction.

stratagems.name: EXPERIMENTAL WEAPONRY
stratagems.type: Experimental Prototype Cadre – Battle Tactic Stratagem
stratagems.legend: T’au scientists have distributed the latest prototype weapons amongst this cadre’s contingents, all optimised to increase reliability and accuracy.
stratagems.description_html:
WHEN: Your Shooting phase.

TARGET: One T’AU EMPIRE unit from your army that has not been selected to shoot this phase.

EFFECT: Until the end of the phase, each time you roll one or more dice to determine the number of attacks made with a weapon equipped by a model in your unit, you can re-roll the result.

stratagems.name: REACTIVE IMPACT DAMPENERS
stratagems.type: Experimental Prototype Cadre – Battle Tactic Stratagem
stratagems.legend: Advancements in battlesuit field technology include the addition of autoreactive shield dampers to absorb and dissipate the energy from high-velocity kinetic strikes.
stratagems.description_html:
WHEN: Your opponent’s Shooting phase or the Fight phase, just after an enemy unit has selected its targets.

TARGET: One T’au Empire Battlesuit unit from your army that was selected as the target of one or more of the attacking unit’s attacks.

EFFECT: Until the end of the phase, each time an attack targets your unit, if the Strength characteristic of that attack is greater than the Toughness characteristic of your unit, subtract 1 from the Wound roll.

stratagems.name: AUTOMATED REPAIR DRONES
stratagems.type: Experimental Prototype Cadre – Strategic Ploy Stratagem
stratagems.legend: Much research is being placed into deploying miniaturised drones to affect battlefield repairs and dispense emergency medical treatments in combat.
stratagems.description_html:
WHEN: Command phase.

TARGET: One T’au Empire Battlesuit unit from your army.

EFFECT: Select one BATTLESUIT model in your unit: that model regains up to D3+1 lost wounds.

stratagems.name: NEUROWEB SYSTEM JAMMER
stratagems.legend: This prototype countermeasure device emits an intense neurostatic jamming field, scrambling the enemy’s senses and fouling their aim.
stratagems.description_html:
WHEN: Your opponent’s Shooting phase, just after an enemy unit has selected its targets.

TARGET: One T’au Empire Crisis unit from your army that was selected as the target of one or more of the attacking unit’s attacks.

EFFECT: Until the end of the phase, your unit can only be selected as the target of a ranged attack if the attacking model is within 18".

stratagems.name: EXPERIMENTAL AMMUNITION
stratagems.legend: From hardened warheads and amplified ion capacitors, to hyperaccelerated pulse fields and refined fusion cores, the T’au are forever innovating improvements to improve the lethality of their ammunition.
stratagems.description_html:
WHEN: Your Shooting phase.

TARGET: One T’AU EMPIRE unit from your army that has not been selected to shoot this phase.

EFFECT: Select one of the following to apply to your unit until the end of the phase:
  • Improve the Strength characteristic of ranged weapons equipped by models in your unit by 1.
  • Improve the Strength and Armour Penetration characteristics of ranged weapons equipped by models in your unit by 1, and those weapons have the [HAZARDOUS] ability.

RESTRICTIONS: You cannot target the same unit with the Experimental Ammunition and Threat Assessment Analyser Stratagems in the same phase.
stratagems.description_text:

TARGET: One T’AU EMPIRE unit from your army that has not been selected to shoot this phase.

EFFECT: Select one of the following to apply to your unit until the end of the phase:
Improve the Strength characteristic of ranged weapons equipped by models in your unit by 1.
Improve the Strength and Armour Penetration characteristics of ranged weapons equipped by models in your unit by 1, and those weapons have the [HAZARDOUS] ability.

RESTRICTIONS: You cannot target the same unit with the Experimental Ammunition and Threat Assessment Analyser Stratagems in the same phase.

stratagems.name: THREAT ASSESSMENT ANALYSER
stratagems.legend: The Earth caste have been experimenting with implanting AI neurochip-technology into hand-held scanners, enabling the swift calculation of precise firing solutions.
stratagems.description_html:
WHEN: Your Shooting phase.

TARGET: One T’AU EMPIRE unit from your army that has not been selected to shoot this phase.

EFFECT: Select the [SUSTAINED HITS 1] or [LETHAL HITS] ability. Until the end of the phase, ranged weapons equipped by models in your unit have the selected ability. You can instead select the [SUSTAINED HITS 1], [LETHAL HITS] and [HAZARDOUS] abilities to apply to those weapons until the end of the phase.

RESTRICTIONS: You cannot target the same unit with the Experimental Ammunition and Threat Assessment Analyser Stratagems in the same phase.

enhancements.name: Supernova Launcher
enhancements.legend: Adapted from standard-issue fragmentation projectors, this weapon enables the bearer to fire explosive plasma charges on parabolic trajectories. These projectiles drop amongst the enemy and explode in a coruscating fireball that evaporates metal and flesh alike.
enhancements.description_html: T’AU EMPIRE model only. Select one airbursting fragmentation projector equipped by the bearer. Improve the Strength characteristic of that weapon by 3, and improve the Armour Penetration and Damage characteristics of that weapon by 1.
enhancements.description_text: T’AU EMPIRE model only. Select one airbursting fragmentation projector equipped by the bearer. Improve the Strength characteristic of that weapon by 3, and improve the Armour Penetration and Damage characteristics of that weapon by 1.

enhancements.name: Thermoneutronic Projector
enhancements.legend: The thermoneutronic projector uses volatile gases siphoned from the coronae of neutron stars to expel a flame capable of searing through the armour plating of a battle tank.
enhancements.description_html: T’AU EMPIRE model only. Select one T’au flamer equipped by the bearer. Improve the Strength characteristic of that weapon by 2, and improve the Armour Penetration and Damage characteristics of that weapon by 1.
enhancements.description_text: T’AU EMPIRE model only. Select one T’au flamer equipped by the bearer. Improve the Strength characteristic of that weapon by 2, and improve the Armour Penetration and Damage characteristics of that weapon by 1.

enhancements.name: Plasma Accelerator Rifle
enhancements.legend: The plasma accelerator rifle blends pulse-induction technology with a high-yield plasma generator, rendering it highly effective against both infantry and light vehicles.
enhancements.description_html: T’AU EMPIRE model only. Select one plasma rifle equipped by the bearer. Improve the Strength characteristic of that weapon by 2, and improve the Attacks, Armour Penetration and Damage characteristics of that weapon by 1.
enhancements.description_text: T’AU EMPIRE model only. Select one plasma rifle equipped by the bearer. Improve the Strength characteristic of that weapon by 2, and improve the Attacks, Armour Penetration and Damage characteristics of that weapon by 1.

enhancements.name: Fusion Blades
enhancements.legend: Fusion blades resemble modified versions of the T’au fusion blaster. However, when fired, each weapon unleashes a continuous beam of volatile energy that extends from the muzzle of the weapon.
enhancements.description_html: T’AU EMPIRE model only. Select one fusion blaster equipped by the bearer. Improve the Attacks characteristic of that weapon by 1, improve the Strength characteristic of that weapon by 3, and that weapon has the [MELTA 4] ability.
